inlines.v: LAT'TER, adjective [an irregular comparative of late.] 1. Coming or happening after something else; opposed to former; as the former and latter rain; former or latter harvest. 2. Mentioned the last of two. The difference between reason and revelation - and in what sense the latter is superior. 3. Modern; lately done or past; as in these latter ages.
